Flydubai Jet Nearly Shot Down Over Tel Aviv After Co-Pilot's Alleged Plan

Israel was prepared to shoot down a flydubai jet if it had continued on a path towards Tel Aviv, following an alleged cockpit stabbing attack, according to a CBS News report. The Omani co-pilot of the Boeing 737 may have shut off the engines after his plan to crash the aircraft into Tel Aviv airport failed. Reports suggest the co-pilot's actions were linked to a potential terror attack.
